title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Cat 2 Day 30
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzwjp7e
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Cleveland Clinic animal team euthanizes the animal

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat and prepare the surgical site.

substeps.instruction: Shave the abdomen.
Attach the animal to monitors in the surgery room.
Drape the animal.
Perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Place a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder via the urethra.

substeps.instruction: Apply surgilube to the 3.5Fr catheter.
Insert the catheter into the bladder through the urethra.
Advance the catheter until resistance is met, then pull back 2-3cm.

steps.title: Collect Urine for Analysis
steps.instruction: Withdraw and measure urine from the bladder.

substeps.instruction: Use gentle suction with a syringe to withdraw urine through the catheter.
Measure the volume of the withdrawn urine.
Save the urine for urinalysis.

steps.title: Perform Contrast CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize the bladder using a contrast agent and CT imaging.

substeps.instruction: Use a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline to visualize the bladder.
Take a 3D CT image with the contrast:saline in the bladder.

steps.title: Set Up Urodynamics Recording
steps.instruction: Configure the pressure recording system after transitioning the animal's anesthesia.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic.
Set the syringe pump fill rate to 2ml saline/minute.
Connect an external pressure transducer to the syringe pump on one end and the tubing leading to the catheter on the other.
Prepare to record data using Labview software.

steps.title: Perform Bladder Filling and Pressure Recording
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline and record the pressure via the transducer and LabView.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at a rate of 2ml/min.
Fill to 30 mL.
Record the pressure (Peak pressure around 20 cmH2O).
End round 2 urodynamics.

steps.title: Harvest Bladder for Analysis
steps.instruction: Remove the bladder for histological examination.

substeps.instruction: Remove the bladder.
Examine the bladder.
Place the bladder in formalin for histological analysis.
